description: USE THIS before calculating VAT or sales tax on an invoice/quote — never recall the rate from memory, it is DATE-SENSITIVE. GB returns the UK standard VAT rate that applied on the given date (handles historical/temporary changes). US has no national VAT (returns 0); pass a state code for the state base sales-tax rate. Always pass the invoice date for GB.

state.description: US state code (e.g. CA) for sales tax.

name: tax_rate
